tools.name: search_ski_lessons
tools.description: Search open SkiTribu groups ('tribes') that share a private ski or snowboard instructor in a ski resort (mostly France: Val Thorens, Les Arcs, Tignes, Chamonix, La Plagne, Courchevel, Serre Chevalier, Orcières…). Returns each group's resort, dates, level, audience (adults/children), places left and

tools.name: list_ski_resorts
tools.description: Find French ski resorts by name, region or massif (e.g. 'Savoie', 'Pyrénées', 'Alpes du Sud', 'Arcs'), with their ski schools (ESF, ESI and others), the number of open SkiTribu groups and the resort page link.

tools.name: get_tribe
tools.description: Details of one SkiTribu group from its link or slug (the part after /tribus/): resort, school, level, all lesson dates, places left, deadline.

tools.name: create_tribe_link
tools.description: When no group matches, build a SkiTribu link that opens the 'create my tribe' form already filled with the resort, sport, level and dates. Creating a group is free; the user becomes the group leader and chooses who joins.

tools.name: how_skitribu_works
tools.description: Explains SkiTribu: free connection service, groups of 1 to 6 people of the same level, level quiz, leader approval, each person pays their share to the ski school.
